stem: Castlemere Robotics is on Terraform 1.9 and wants to pass a freshly generated password into a resource's write-only argument without it ever touching the state file. Can they, on this version?

choices.text: No -- write-only arguments need Terraform 1.5 or later, the same floor as `check` blocks
Yes -- write-only arguments have no minimum version requirement at all
Yes, as long as the value is also marked `sensitive` first, which is the flag that unlocks write-only argument support for that resource
No -- write-only arguments need Terraform 1.11 or later, and this version doesn't meet that floor

rationale: Write-only arguments need Terraform 1.11 or later, and 1.9 doesn't meet that floor, so this configuration would not work as described on that version. b names a real version floor, but it's the one for check blocks, not write-only arguments. c is wrong because a minimum version does exist. d is wrong; sensitive and write-only are unrelated mechanisms, and marking a value sensitive doesn't unlock or enable write-only argument support.
